svg.title: DiveFrame offline world map
svg.description: An equirectangular world map with broad geographic labels for orienting dive markers.
svg.metadata: Source: world-atlas 2.0.2 (Natural Earth 4.1.0) (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/world-atlas@2.0.2/countries-110m.json; repository https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas/tree/v2.0.2). The country data is derived from Natural Earth's 1:110m Admin 0 boundaries. Natural Earth data is public domain (https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/); the world-atlas redistribution license is tracked in scripts/map-data/world-atlas-LICENSE. Transformation: pinned TopoJSON countries converted with d3-geo to a 1200 by 600 equirectangular viewBox; projected coordinates rounded to two decimals. English orientation labels added by DiveFrame.
